section.34: The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten

34.name_native: The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten

hadiths.text: Bara' b. 'Azib reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded us to throw away the flesh of domestic asses whether uncooked or cooked; he then never commanded us to eat that
